text: Reads an invoice JSON file as input
Input schema: customer, items (description, quantity, unit price), tax rate, optional discount
Discount is optional; invoice without discount is valid
Validates input (missing/invalid fields, types, negative values, etc.)
Reports all validation errors at once rather than stopping at the first
Invalid input yields an error exit (non-zero) and no invoice output
Computes line totals (quantity x unit price)
Correct money rounding (decimal arithmetic, half-up to cents, no float artifacts)
Malformed JSON / missing file handled gracefully with a clear error
